features.source: Held in fact and recognised by no state at all, which is why it is drawn as contested throughout. Drawn at its eleven-state extent from the founding of the provisional government: the secessions ran from South Carolina in December 1860 to Tennessee in June 1861, and separating them would need a carve for every state. Kentucky and Missouri were claimed and starred on the flag but never controlled, so they are not drawn.
West Virginia admitted to the Union as a state of its own. The end date is the surrender of the Trans-Mississippi, the last army in the field, rather than Appomattox six weeks earlier.
